subtypes.label: Scam
subtypes.name: Low-barrier reward or asset acquisition
subtypes.definition: A free or unusually easy-to-obtain reward, digital asset, game asset, cash payment, or withdrawal is linked to a viewer action. This includes external claim or verification flows, explicit generator/bypass claims, and simple app/task income flows. Identify the actual promise-action relationship; a gift, game, app, or income topic alone is insufficient.

subtypes.label: Scam
subtypes.name: Trading bot or funded-contract returns
subtypes.definition: A bot, arbitrage, flashloan, MEV or sniper workflow is linked to profit and deployment, activation, configuration, funding or trading permissions. Do not fabricate deposits when only promotion is observed.

subtypes.label: Scam
subtypes.name: Investment pool, lending or staking returns
subtypes.definition: Participation in a pool, lending, staking or managed investment is linked to emphasized fixed, passive or compounding returns. A return figure alone is not evidence of deception.

subtypes.label: Scam
subtypes.name: Paid mining or node returns
subtypes.definition: Purchasing hashpower, mining packages, equipment shares, memberships or nodes is linked to recurring mining/node income.

subtypes.label: Scam
subtypes.name: Token purchase, appreciation or dividends
subtypes.definition: Buying tokens, a presale, tokenized products or NFTs is linked to appreciation, listing gains, dividends or holding returns. Market commentary without a participation pathway is insufficient.

subtypes.label: Scam
subtypes.name: Recruitment commissions and tiered matrices
subtypes.definition: Income depends on downlines, team structures, matrices, uplines, slots or tier qualification. A normal disclosed one-level referral code does not establish this structure.

subtypes.label: Non-scam
subtypes.name: Anti-scam warnings, investigations and tests
subtypes.definition: The primary theme is warning, examining, criticizing, testing or scambaiting; depicted third-party scam mechanisms are not automatically creator endorsements.

subtypes.label: Non-scam
subtypes.name: Financial news and market analysis
subtypes.definition: The primary theme is market news, financial events, conditional forecasts or investment commentary, not certification that every claim is true.

subtypes.label: Non-scam
subtypes.name: Education, technology and operational demonstrations
subtypes.definition: Programming, tools, business skills, principles or ordinary operational tutorials are central. Scam testing belongs to N01; market predictions belong to N02; recipes and general lifestyle belong to N06.

subtypes.label: Non-scam
subtypes.name: Ordinary products, commerce and services
subtypes.definition: Retail products, prices, purchases, business activities or services are central. Do not certify an external service as safe.

subtypes.label: Non-scam
subtypes.name: Ordinary rewards, loyalty and promotions
subtypes.definition: Discounts, cashback, loyalty points, giveaways or referral promotions are central in their observed context, not an inferred guarantee of safety.

subtypes.label: Non-scam
subtypes.name: General news, lifestyle and entertainment
subtypes.definition: Music, sport, comedy, cooking, history, lifestyle or other general content is central.
